description: A short prose summary of Ethan's public GitHub contributions over the last 7 days. Plain third-person paragraph — quote it directly when summarizing what he's currently working on.

data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu contributed 53 GitHub commits and 20 pushes to UTMIST/Misty. He opened pull requests in UTMIST/Mist#114 and UTMIST/Misty#271, #284, #293, #294, #307, #308, #309, and #311, and reviewed pull requests across UTMIST/Misty including #206, #259, #261, #262, and #293, as well as UTMIST/UTMIST#487. He also opened issues in UTMIST/Misty and UTMIST/UTMIST, including UTMIST/Misty#270, #272, #273, #274, and UTMIST/UTMIST#495.
